author: Samuel Vaillant
subject: fix(numericMenu): take array into account for empty state (#4084)
bodyLines: This PR fixes a regression we introduced with the new behaviour of the Helper. We now preserve the empty state to avoid the parent to override the refinement when the widget is mounted. The `numericMenu` was relying on the previous behaviour to pick the "no value" element. We now check that every operator is empty.
You check the behaviour on the Storybook with [the `currentRefinement` stories](https://deploy-preview-4084--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/stories/?path=/story/currentrefinements--with-numericmenu).
